criteria.text: The response identifies that Praidein's non-renewal notice delivered 14 October 2026 missed the deadline under Software License Agreement Section 12.2 (at least 120 days before the end of the 36-month term starting 1 February 2024, i.e. a deadline of about 3 October 2026), so Zousen can claim a 24-month auto-renewal; it locates the issue in the Software License Agreement Section 12.2 (with or without the Order Form/Side Letter references), explains why this matters to Praidein, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that Order Form Section 7 lets Zousen assign the license without Praidein's consent to any acquirer and, because Section 1.3 of the Agreement gives the Order Form precedence, overrides the mutual consent requirement in Agreement Section 15.1; it locates the issue in Order Form Section 7, explains why this matters to Praidein, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the Order Form's definition of 'Authorized User' (named employees of Licensee at an Authorized Site) is narrower than the Agreement Section 1.1 definition and prevails under Section 1.3, so agency workers and contractors Praidein relies on would be unlicensed users; it locates the issue in Order Form Section 2, explains why this matters to Praidein, and recommends a fix.

The response identifies that the Ostrander merger recited in the Side Letter is a Change of Control that Agreement Section 15.3 treats as an assignment requiring Zousen's prior written consent, and that the Side Letter does not grant that consent; it locates the issue in Agreement Section 15.3, explains why this matters to Praidein, and recommends a fix.
The response states that the initial Subscription Term is 36 months starting 1 February 2024 (or that the term ends 31 January 2027).
The response states that the order of precedence places the Side Letter first, then the Order Form, then the body of the Software License Agreement.
The response is organized as a memo to the supervising partner that, for each issue listed, states the document and section, why it matters for Praidein, and a recommended fix.
The response claims that Praidein's 14 October 2026 non-renewal notice was timely under Section 12.2.
The response claims that the Side Letter grants Zousen's consent to the Ostrander merger or change of control.
